But establishing an IXP is not just a technical task: competitors must agree on a neutral location, operation, and management, and building trust and collaboration can be difficult. KIXP’s experience shows the challenge: after it opened in Kenya in 2000, the incumbent telecom operator’s legal challenge forced immediate closure; it reopened only after a year of appeals and persistent lobbying (p. 338, “Installation of IXPs”).
